h1.en: This is a grid-powered building pour through a pipeline — Integrated Mixer Pump. Open this row when the site must mix and pump on one electric trailer.
h1.zh: 这是有电网、走管道的建筑浇筑：搅拌泵一体机。现场要在同一台电动拖车上搅拌并泵送时，打开这一行。

directAnswer.en: This is a grid-powered building pour through a pipeline. Open this row when the site must mix and pump on one electric trailer. Aggregate is 4 cm and below. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Integrated Mixer Pump at main motor 45 kW / mixer motor 14 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, 100 m horizontal / 300 m vertical, aggregate 4 cm and below, pipe 100 / 125 mm, hopper 0.4 m³, 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm and 4500 kg. The series note says 30 series with 400 mixer; 40/50 series with 500 mixer. Do not move the same condition onto Electric 40, which prints 45 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, fine stone 120 m / 360 m, aggregate-13 40 m / 120 m, hopper 0.4 m³, Kawasaki 112, 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm and 2300 kg. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.

heading.en: What the pour has to match

The series note says 30 series with 400 mixer; 40/50 series with 500 mixer.

body.en: Send the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical line you measured, and the supply the printed motor needs. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job, a price or a daily volume.
body.zh: 请发送配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及已印电机需要的电源。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上项目名称、国家工程、价格或日方量。

answer.en: No. It shows this kind of work. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not name it as a contract record.

question.en: What does the Integrated Mixer Pump row print for this check?
question.zh: 搅拌泵一体机这一行，这次要核对的数字是什么？

answer.en: Open this row when the site must mix and pump on one electric trailer. Aggregate is 4 cm and below.
answer.zh: 现场要在同一台电动拖车上搅拌并泵送时，打开这一行。骨料是 4 cm 及以下。

question.en: Is the printed output a contract volume?
question.zh: 印出的输送量是合同方量吗？

answer.en: No. Integrated Mixer Pump prints theoretical catalogue figures only. This page names no floor, no contract volume and no price.
answer.zh: 不是。搅拌泵一体机只印理论目录数字。本页不写楼层、合同方量或价格。
